caption: The drawing depicts four jewelry objects arranged on a plain background. At the top center is a brooch or pendant, composed of a central oval with a textured brown and yellow surface, surrounded by a ring of smaller round brown beads, and finished with a single almond-shaped dangle hanging from the bottom. Below the brooch is a horizontal cylindrical object, possibly a bracelet or armlet, featuring a braided pattern in shades of brown, yellow, and a hint of green, with decorative end caps in gold and brown, and details resembling circular and floral designs at the ends. At the bottom center are a pair of earrings, each with a gold hook, a small star-shaped element at the top, and three almond-shaped pendants hanging from an elaborate structure in brown and gold, with intricate patterns matching the other pieces. The overall composition is symmetrical and the color palette consists predominantly of brown, yellow, and gold tones, rendered with detailed linework and shading on a neutral background.
title: Hair Bracelet, Earrings, and Brooch
